text.p: British satellite broadcaster BSkyB on Friday defended a bonus scheme that inflated chief executive Sam Chisholm's total earnings package to 3.8 million stg last year.

Responding to a question from a shareholder, chairman Gerry Robinson told the company's AGM that BSkyB's management had turned in an "outstanding performance". He added that the rewards were relatively modest when compared with what was paid to company bosses in the United States.
Bonuses worth 3.4 million stg took BSkyB chief executive Sam Chisholm's total package to 3.8 million stg in 1995/96, figures in the company's annual report showed.
His deputy David Chance made a total of 2.6 million stg while finance director Richard Brooke earned 767,000 stg.
